revision_summary: One quote-check failure and a couple of internal-consistency/schema-citation issues need fixing before ship: (1) In script_coverage[4] (roof), the customer quote 'There's not enough surface area on the back of the house...' is timestamped 00:51 but actually occurs around 01:50-01:59 in the transcript — correct the ts. (2) Reconcile the contradictory characterization of the 00:17-00:30 moment: cherry_pick_moments correctly reads the rep's 'Okay' as a non-engaged flat acknowledgment, but script_coverage[9] (prior_design) labels the same beat 'completed' with rep_followup 'persisted' — pick one consistent read; the cherry-pick read is better supported. (3) In objections[0], drop or reweight 'Okay.' as a counted 'rep_attempt' — it's passive acknowledgment, not an active handling attempt, and inflates the appearance of engagement. (4) Loosen or caveat the schema citation in cherry_pick_moments[1] (dq_rules.roof_too_old_no_replacement as 'analogous') and cherry_pick_moments[6] (button_up as 'contrast') — both are being used as loose analogies to sections that don't actually govern the situation; either drop the citation or make explicit these are inferential parallels, not applicable schema requirements. Also fold in the missed moment at 02:44 ('I'm not taking my trees down... I said trim, not remove') — a real communication misfire adjacent to the manager-hold that a manager would want visible. Outcome dispute to 'dq' is well-supported and should be kept as-is.
